## Today

`PasteErrorUiState` already carries `expectedRow: LabelRef?` beside
`rawRow: String?`, with the class doc stating `expectedRow` is
non-null exactly when `rawRow` is non-null
(`app-phone/.../ui/pasteerror/PasteErrorUiState.kt`).
`PasteErrorViewModel.buildUiState` sets `expectedRow` to
`PhoneStringResources.PasteError.expectedRowExample` whenever
`failure.rawRow` is non-null, for every failure cause
(`PasteErrorViewModel.kt`). `PasteErrorScreen` renders `rawRow` and
`expectedRow` together, guarded by `rendersRowComparison(uiState)`,
which is true exactly when both are non-null (`PasteErrorScreen.kt`).
`PasteErrorScreenTest` and `PasteErrorViewModelTest` both exercise
this pairing. The code already does what the gap describes as
missing — no field is absent and the screen does not show `rawRow`
alone.
